name: Planar Human
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Planar humans are exceedingly rare, as the gods realize that humans are best suited to serve them on the Material Plane, and thus work hard to dissuade them from establishing communities elsewhere. Humans that do thrive here tend to be wanderers who are extremely adaptable and focused on survival above all else.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain a +2 bonus to any two ability scores of your choice. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and your choice of Abyssal, Celestial, or Infernal. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any language except for secret languages. This trait alters languages.
Sprinter You gain a +10 foot species bonus to your speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.
Versatile Education At 1st level, choose any combination of two languages, skills, or weapons. You learn those languages, gain those skills as a class skills, and/or gain proficiency with those weapons. Alternatively, you can use one of your choices to gain proficiency with shields (except for tower shields), to upgrade your shield proficiency to include tower shields, and/or to upgrade your armor proficiency to the next level (from no armor to light armor, medium armor, and heavy armor, in that order).

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
